title: DOUBLON-FUNCTION DETECTION — MCP Server Code & DB Layer
summary: Focused scan for duplicate function-level logic across MCP server, DB layer, and system files. Detected 3 live doublons (CRITICAL FIX NEEDED) + 10 proposed from prior runs still pending. Total scan: MCP server 1891 functions across 147 tool handlers.

critical_live_doublons.category: Puppeteer page setup duplication — inline code block

locations.description: Page creation + setUserAgent + setRequestInterception + request event handler
Identical page setup: setUserAgent + setRequestInterception + request event handler

critical_live_doublons.duplicated_logic: Both functions create a Puppeteer page and configure identical request interception: (1) setUserAgent(TE_USER_AGENT), (2) setRequestInterception(true), (3) page.on('request') handler that blocks requests matching TE_BLOCKED_PATTERNS via regex replacement /^\*\*\// and /\/\*\*$/ pattern extraction. The request handler is copy-pasted with identical logic.
critical_live_doublons.canonical_target: Extract to private _setupPuppeteerPage(browser) helper in tradingEconomicsChromium.ts, return configured page. Both playwrightScrape and playwrightScrapeNews call the helper.
critical_live_doublons.reason: Both inline blocks are identical (19 LOC each). Extract is a pure refactoring with no behavioral change. Both functions remain untested (deps.scrape mocked), but extraction reduces future maintenance burden when anti-bot patterns change. Single-file change, no test coverage impact.
critical_live_doublons.why_matter: Any future User-Agent rotation, blocked-pattern addition, or request handler fix requires editing both locations. Silent divergence risk on next browser hardening (Task 1834b follow-up).

critical_live_doublons.category: Puppeteer browser launch duplication — duplicated dynamic import

locations.description: const puppeteer = await import('puppeteer-core'); const browser = await puppeteer.launch(buildChromiumLaunchConfig())
Identical: const puppeteer = await import('puppeteer-core'); const browser = await puppeteer.launch(buildChromiumLaunchConfig())

critical_live_doublons.duplicated_logic: Three separate files (tradingEconomicsChromium × 2, chromiumPageFetcher × 1) all perform the same 5-line pattern: (1) dynamic import puppeteer-core, (2) extract .default, (3) await puppeteer.launch(buildChromiumLaunchConfig()), (4) optional error handling in finally with browser.close().
critical_live_doublons.canonical_target: Extract to infrastructure/fetchers/chromiumLaunchHelper.ts: export async function launchChromiumBrowser(): Promise<Browser> { const puppeteer = await import('puppeteer-core'); return puppeteer.launch(buildChromiumLaunchConfig()); }. All three call sites import and use the helper.
critical_live_doublons.reason: Pure mechanical extraction. Return type is Puppeteer Browser. All three call sites use browser identically (newPage, goto, content, close). Single-file creation + 3-file import updates. No behavioral change, no test coverage needed.
critical_live_doublons.why_matter: Future Puppeteer version updates, buildChromiumLaunchConfig changes, or new browser-launch callers require edits in 3+ files. Centralizing reduces error surface.

critical_live_doublons.category: Cache age calculation — duplicated interval math

locations.description: function cacheAgeMs(entry: TeCacheEntry): number { return Date.now() - new Date(entry.cachedAt).getTime(); }
function newsCacheAgeMs(entry: TeNewsCacheEntry): number { return Date.now() - new Date(entry.cachedAt).getTime(); }

critical_live_doublons.duplicated_logic: Two helper functions with identical implementation: compute milliseconds elapsed since entry.cachedAt timestamp. The only difference is parameter type (TeCacheEntry vs TeNewsCacheEntry), both with identical cachedAt: string field.
critical_live_doublons.canonical_target: Extract to single helper: export function cacheAgeMs(entry: { cachedAt: string }): number { return Date.now() - new Date(entry.cachedAt).getTime(); }. Both call sites use identical interface (the cachedAt field).
critical_live_doublons.reason: Pure utility function, no dependencies on entry subfields. Both types share { cachedAt: string }. Single-file refactor (remove newsCacheAgeMs, update its call site to use cacheAgeMs). Test coverage: 0 (both functions are untested; they are test utilities).
critical_live_doublons.why_matter: Minimal impact, but reduces cognitive overhead — one name, one implementation for cache age. Future time-constant changes benefit from single edit point.

proposed_from_prior_runs.reason: These were identified in prior scans (scan-16, scan-19) but require multi-file changes or architectural decisions. Code-janitor role constraint: ship single-file mechanical only; escalate multi-file to developer.
